title: Known-object test, TOI-1835.02
summary: Known-object test on TOI-1835.02: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 589 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 2 light curve(s), forming 230 distinct event(s), 21 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2458938.4279 (ΔT 0.54 d); 0 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
